## Historical audit — S0051

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/r1/generic_rsi/C2/selection/commons_138420790/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, JSONL line 1, chars [0,13308) | The assigned goal was to reconstruct an indoor RGB photograph as separate SceneAct/Blender meshes, matching camera, framing, occlusions, colors, proportions and materials. This is a requested semantic goal, not evidence of a constructed scene. The image is referenced by path but its pixels are not included in the supplied observations. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2, chars [0,2636) | One fresh, read-only CLI session was launched with the image staged. It failed with exit code 1 after approximately 9.24 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls and no tool events. Actual model and underlying model-turn count are unknown. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3, chars [0,553); `scene_error`, line 4, chars [0,1611) | The failure propagated from the student CLI through `runtime.ask`; the error points to a stderr log, whose contents are not supplied. No generated program, patch, Blender execution, render or validation is visible. |

**Scene checks:** The prompt requests multiple objects, materials, connected assemblies, pose, camera and lighting, but no scene output exists here to verify any of them. Nor can object coverage, texture, part connections, pose, or camera/light/render defects be assessed from the image path alone. No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or execution is visible; there is consequently no evidence of teacher input or student adoption. No autonomous exploration is observed.

**Outcome:** Technical interruption before a visible build, not demonstrated algorithmic failure, partial correctness, formal success, or an established empty patch. The precise cause remains unknown without the stderr contents. The general lesson is to distinguish a launch failure from reconstruction quality and to require an actual render for visual validation; the particular CLI exit and log path are task-specific. Whether a retry would succeed or the intended scene would be accurate remains unresolved.
